$comment: A stack profile: everything the core loop needs to know about what a project is built with. The core (loop/run.mjs, loop/lib, loop/guard/core.mjs) names no framework, host or database; it reads the profile that "profile" in loop/loop.config.json names. Order of precedence: defaults in loop/lib/config.mjs, then this file, then loop/loop.config.json. The contract is described in loop/profiles/README.md.
